_comment: Structural data for area pages. Content lives in data/content/areas/<slug>.json. neighbours = 3 nearby areas that have their own page (used for internal links). hints = factual prompts for copywriters only (not rendered).

areas.name: London
areas.hints: Parent page for all Greater London. Covers all 32 boroughs + City. Link to the 7 sub-area pages. Mention Congestion Charge / ULEZ as practical notes (we handle it), venue loading bays, lifts, timed access.
